question: Can a typed semantic action that reuses an emitted legacy movement family and adds one guarded persistent boolean effect expose a legal auxiliary-bearing action on a fresh generated legacy substrate?
changed_premise: The earlier four-rule preflight used a fixed (1,2) compound-action geometry and found no legal compound action. This check instead binds semantic geometry to the generated piece's own leap/ray family and adds a persistent slot guard/write.
scope: Eight fresh 6x6 classic-like generated substrates, seeds 202610401 through 202610408. For each, deterministically select one non-anchor, non-promotable generated piece type and one of its emitted leap/ray families; add one augment action with move + set_bool. Compile, count root semantic actions, and submit the first one if present. No search, game outcome, price, training, or seed filtering.
decision_rule: If no candidate action appears in any of eight roots, do not use this template as a first generator profile. If any appear and one legal submission changes auxiliary state while recording history, the template is feasible as a narrow opt-in prototype only; it does not establish full DSL/domain coverage or utility. Preserve every seed and exception.
